name: Food
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided plants and fruit as food for mankind and animals, emphasizing His provision and care for all living creatures (Genesis 1:29-30). After the Flood, God expanded this provision to include every moving creature as food for humans, demonstrating a gracious allowance for dietary needs (Genesis 9:3). The hospitality shown by Abraham, who served bread, butter, milk, and meat to his guests, highlights the blessing and comfort associated with sharing food in fellowship (Genesis 18:5-8). These passages collectively affirm that food is a God-given provision meant for sustenance, blessing, and communal encouragement.
